mainTopic: Whether רבנן and רבן גמליאל disagree about זיקה, and רבי יוחנן's list of תנאים who hold that מאמר is a full acquisition
overview: The amud opens in the middle of an argument about a ברייתא where רבן גמליאל and רבנן disagree about a גט after a גט and a מאמר after a מאמר. The גמרא first tries to read their dispute as a dispute about זיקה. That reading would make רבנן clash with רבה בר רב הונא in the name of רב, who said an invalid חליצה must be repeated with all the brothers. He answers that both sides hold אין זיקה and argue only about a second גט or a second מאמר. The גמרא then quotes רבן גמליאל's ruling again and asks why the first woman cannot have ייבום. It answers that this is a rabbinic גזירה, so he won't come to do ייבום with the second woman. Next, רבי יוחנן says that רבן גמליאל, בית שמאי, רבי שמעון, בן עזאי and רבי נחמיה all hold that מאמר is a full acquisition. The גמרא brings a source for each of the five. Finally, it returns to the משנה's next line, 'כיצד? עשה מאמר', to begin a new discussion.

steps.title: If the Rabbis hold there is a levirate bond, the ending of the ברייתא seems to clash with רב
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes its inference that רבנן hold יש זיקה. It then points to the ending of the ברייתא, which applies the same rules to two יבמין and one יבמה, and suggests this is a refutation of רבה בר רב הונא in the name of רב, who said that after an invalid חליצה the יבמה must do חליצה with all the brothers.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Rabbis hold there is a levirate bond. And the end of the ברייתא teaches: 'You say the same about two יבמין and one יבמה.' Shall we say this refutes what רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב? For רבה בר רב הונא said in the name of רב: after an invalid חליצה, she must go back and do חליצה with all the brothers.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא draws a conclusion about what רבנן hold and uses it to challenge a ruling of רב. If רבנן hold יש זיקה, their view in the ברייתא seems to contradict רב.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ending of the ברייתא suggests that when two brothers are involved with one יבמה, a single brother's חליצה can settle the case. רב's ruling, which is understood to fit the view of יש זיקה, says that a flawed release ties her to every brother. If רבנן hold יש זיקה and still don't require all the brothers, they seem to contradict רב.

keyTerms.meaning: The levirate bond that ties the יבמה to the brothers before ייבום or חליצה
The latter clause or ending of a משנה or ברייתא
A refutation, a strong challenge to a ruling
An invalid חליצה, one done with a flaw
Brothers of the dead husband who are obligated in ייבום

steps.confusionAlert: The first words ('the Rabbis hold there is a levirate bond') are the end of a sentence that started before this section. The גמרא inferred that רבן גמליאל holds אין זיקה, so it assumed רבנן, who argue with him, must hold יש זיקה.

phrases.english: The Rabbis hold there is a levirate bond,
and the latter clause teaches:
And you say the same
regarding two yevamin and one yevama.
Shall we say it is a refutation

phrases.aramaic: דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב.
phrases.english: of what Rabba bar Rav Huna said in the name of Rav?

phrases.aramaic: דְּאָמַר רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב:
phrases.english: For Rabba bar Rav Huna said in the name of Rav:
After an invalid chalitza,
she must go back to all the brothers.
phrases.notes: He means she has to do חליצה again with every one of the brothers, not just one.

steps.triggerLanguage: לֵימָא תֶּיהְוֵי תְּיוּבְתָּא דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא אָמַר רַב
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the earlier inference about זיקה and turns it into a challenge against רב
steps.kashyaTarget: The ruling of רבה בר רב הונא in the name of רב that an invalid חליצה requires חליצה with all the brothers
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If רבנן hold יש זיקה and still let one brother's חליצה settle the case in the ending of the ברייתא, they contradict רב's ruling, which is built on יש זיקה.

steps.title: Both sides hold there is no levirate bond; they only argue about a second divorce or a second betrothal
steps.stepSummary: רבה בר רב הונא answers that both רבן גמליאל and רבנן hold אין זיקה. Their real dispute is only whether a גט after a גט, or a מאמר after a מאמר, has any effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבה בר רב הונא can say to you: Both רבן גמליאל and רבנן hold there is no levirate bond. Here they argue about a גט after a גט and a מאמר after a מאמר.
steps.whatsHappening: רבה בר רב הונא defends his ruling. He says the ברייתא is not about זיקה at all.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once both sides hold אין זיקה, the ברייתא is no proof against רב, whose ruling fits the opposing view of יש זיקה. The argument in the ברייתא is limited to the issue it states openly: does a second גט or a second מאמר accomplish anything?

keyTerms.meaning: There is no binding levirate bond
A bill of divorce given after a bill of divorce was already given
Levirate betrothal, a rabbinic betrothal of the יבמה with money or a document before ייבום
They disagree

steps.whatToRemember: The dispute between רבן גמליאל and רבנן is not about זיקה. Both hold אין זיקה, and they argue only about whether a second גט or second מאמר works.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר לָךְ רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא:
phrases.english: Rabba bar Rav Huna can say to you:
Both according to Rabban Gamliel and according to the Rabbis,
they hold there is no levirate bond,
and here, regarding a bill of divorce after a bill of divorce
and levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal, they disagree.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָךְ רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 1 by rejecting its assumption that רבנן hold יש זיקה
steps.terutzResolutionType: Rejects the premise: both sides hold the same view on זיקה
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבנן hold יש זיקה and therefore contradict רב
steps.terutzMaskana: Both sides hold אין זיקה. The dispute is only about a second גט or second מאמר, so רב is not refuted

steps.title: Quoting רבן גמליאל's ruling about two levirate betrothals
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the ברייתא again: if the יבם did מאמר with two יבמות, רבן גמליאל says he gives the first one a גט and does חליצה with her. He is forbidden to her relatives but permitted to the relatives of the second.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Master said: If he did מאמר with this one and מאמר with that one, רבן גמליאל says: He gives a גט to the first and does חליצה with her. He is forbidden to her relatives and permitted to the relatives of the second.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes a line from the ברייתא so it can ask a question about it in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבן גמליאל treats only the first מאמר as meaningful. That is why the יבם has a connection to the first woman's relatives and none to the second's. The second מאמר is treated as if it did nothing.

keyTerms.meaning: Her relatives, women forbidden because of a relationship to her
Performs חליצה

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר מָר: עָשָׂה מַאֲמָר בָּזוֹ וּמַאֲמָר בָּזוֹ,
phrases.english: The Master said: If he performed levirate betrothal with this one and levirate betrothal with that one,
Rabban Gamliel says:
He gives a bill of divorce to the first one and performs chalitza with her,
and he is forbidden to her relatives,
and permitted to the relatives of the second one.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר מָר: עָשָׂה מַאֲמָר בָּזוֹ וּמַאֲמָר בָּזוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new discussion by re-quoting a line of the ברייתא
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבן גמליאל, after two מאמרים the first woman gets a גט and חליצה, and only her relatives are forbidden.

steps.title: If the second betrothal does nothing, why can't he marry the first?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks: if רבן גמליאל holds that a מאמר after a מאמר has no effect, the first woman should be allowed to go ahead with ייבום. Why does she need a גט and חליצה?
steps.simpleTranslation: Now, since רבן גמליאל holds that a מאמר after a מאמר does nothing, let the first woman also go ahead with ייבום!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out what looks like a contradiction inside רבן גמליאל's own view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the second מאמר is meaningless, nothing should stand in the way of ייבום with the first woman. Yet רבן גמליאל requires a גט and חליצה for her. The גמרא wants to know why.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Now, since...', which opens a question built on an accepted point
She should be taken in ייבום

phrases.english: Now, since Rabban Gamliel holds
that levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal has no effect,
the first one should also be allowed levirate marriage!

steps.triggerLanguage: מִכְּדֵי קָסָבַר רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אֵין מַאֲמָר אַחַר מַאֲמָר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the ruling quoted in step 3
steps.kashyaTarget: רבן גמליאל's requirement of a גט and חליצה for the first woman
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: If the second מאמר has no effect, the first woman's status should allow ייבום, so requiring חליצה seems unnecessary.

steps.title: A rabbinic decree so he won't marry the second woman
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that ייבום with the first woman is forbidden because of a rabbinic גזירה. The concern is that he might come to do ייבום with the second woman too.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is a decree, in case he comes to do ייבום with the second woman.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains that the ban on ייבום with the first woman is a rabbinic precaution.
steps.deeperAnalysis: By Torah law the first woman could have ייבום. Because he did מאמר with both women, though, the חכמים worried that allowing ייבום with the first could lead him to do ייבום with the second as well. So they required חליצה.

keyTerms.meaning: A rabbinic decree made as a protective measure
Lest, perhaps
To perform ייבום

steps.whyThisMatters: This shows that רבן גמליאל's requirement of חליצה here is a rabbinic precaution. It does not mean the second מאמר took effect.

phrases.english: It is a decree, lest he come to perform levirate marriage with the second one.

steps.terutzResolutionType: A rabbinic decree explains the stricter outcome
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The first woman should be allowed ייבום, since the second מאמר did nothing
steps.terutzMaskana: By strict law she could have ייבום, but the חכמים forbade it so he won't do ייבום with the second

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: five תנאים hold that levirate betrothal is a full acquisition
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן says that רבן גמליאל, בית שמאי, רבי שמעון, בן עזאי and רבי נחמיה all hold that מאמר acquires the יבמה fully, like a regular betrothal.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: רבן גמליאל, בית שמאי, רבי שמעון, בן עזאי and רבי נחמיה all hold that מאמר is a full acquisition.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן makes a new statement that groups five תנאים together on one view of מאמר. The גמרא will now show where each one's view comes from.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The question is how strong a מאמר is. Is it a partial tie, or does it fully acquire the woman the way regular קידושין does? רבי יוחנן claims these five תנאים all treat it as complete.

keyTerms.meaning: A full, complete acquisition
They all hold
Acquires

phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said:
Rabban Gamliel, and Beit Shammai,

phrases.aramaic: וְרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן וּבֶן עַזַּאי וְרַבִּי נְחֶמְיָה —
phrases.english: and Rabbi Shimon, and ben Azzai, and Rabbi Neḥemya,
all of them hold
that levirate betrothal acquires as a full acquisition.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins a new discussion that builds on רבן גמליאל's view of מאמר
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Five תנאים hold that מאמר is a full acquisition.

steps.title: The source for רבן גמליאל is what was already said
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא shows the source for including רבן גמליאל in רבי יוחנן's list: his ruling that a מאמר after a מאמר has no effect.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבן גמליאל: that which we said.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins proving רבי יוחנן's list, one name at a time. For רבן גמליאל it points back to his ruling in the ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבן גמליאל holds that a second מאמר does nothing. That makes sense if the first מאמר already acquired the woman completely, leaving nothing for the second to do.

keyTerms.meaning: That which we said already

phrases.english: Rabban Gamliel: that which we said.
phrases.notes: This points back to his ruling that a מאמר after a מאמר does nothing (step 3).

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports the first name in רבי יוחנן's list
steps.raayaObject: That רבן גמליאל holds מאמר is a full acquisition
steps.raayaSupportSource: His ruling in the ברייתא that a מאמר after a מאמר has no effect

steps.title: The source for including בית שמאי
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a משנה where בית שמאי treat a woman who received מאמר as a full wife. Because of that, her sister who later falls to the same יבם is released as 'sister of a wife'.
steps.simpleTranslation: The source for בית שמאי is a משנה: Three brothers. Two are married to two sisters, and one is single. One of the sisters' husbands dies, and the single brother does מאמר with his widow. Then the second married brother dies. בית שמאי say: his wife stays with him, and the other sister is released because she is his wife's sister.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows why רבי יוחנן put בית שמאי on his list. It quotes a משנה where בית שמאי treat a woman who got מאמר exactly like a wife.
steps.deeperAnalysis: בית שמאי call the woman who received מאמר 'his wife'. She simply stays with him, and her sister is released as an ordinary אחות אשה. That only works if the מאמר made her a full wife. If it were only a partial tie, the two sisters would be on equal footing, and the first could not simply stay with him.

keyTerms.meaning: Free, unattached: here, the single brother who is not married
His wife stays with him: the woman he did מאמר with counts as his wife
A wife's sister, who is forbidden to the husband
This other one: the second sister

phrases.english: Beit Shammai — as we learned in a mishna:
Three brothers,
two of them married to two sisters,
and one is single.
One of the sisters' husbands died,
and the single brother did levirate betrothal with her,
and afterward his second brother died.
Beit Shammai say: His wife stays with him,
and this other one leaves, because she is his wife's sister.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After proving רבן גמליאל in step 7, the גמרא moves to the next name on רבי יוחנן's list.
steps.raayaObject: That בית שמאי hold מאמר fully acquires the יבמה
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה of three brothers, two married to two sisters, where בית שמאי say 'אשתו עמו'

steps.title: The source for including רבי שמעון
steps.stepSummary: רבי שמעון says that if a first nine-year-old's ביאה counts, a second nine-year-old's ביאה does nothing. Since the Rabbis treat a nine-year-old's ביאה like מאמר, רבי שמעון must hold that מאמר fully acquires the יבמה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The source for רבי שמעון is a ברייתא: רבי שמעון said to the חכמים: If the first brother's ביאה counts, the second brother's ביאה does not count. If the first one's ביאה does not count, the second one's ביאה also does not count. Now, the ביאה of a nine-year-old is treated by the Rabbis like מאמר, and רבי שמעון says the second one's ביאה does not count.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows why רבי יוחנן listed רבי שמעון. It quotes his argument about two young brothers who each had relations with the יבמה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The Rabbis say a nine-year-old's ביאה has the same power as מאמר. רבי שמעון says that after the first boy's ביאה, the second boy's ביאה does nothing. So in his view, an act with the strength of מאמר acquires her completely and blocks anything after it.

keyTerms.meaning: Relations by a boy of nine years and a day, which the Rabbis treat like מאמר
The first brother's relations
The second brother's relations
The Rabbis made it equal to

steps.confusionAlert: רבי שמעון's argument here is about two nine-year-old brothers. The point for our סוגיא is only the comparison: a nine-year-old's ביאה is like מאמר, so what he says about it tells us his view on מאמר.

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon — as it is taught in a baraita:
phrases.notes: This is about the case of two brothers, each nine years and a day old, who both had relations with the יבמה.

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon said to the Sages:
If the first one's intercourse counts as intercourse,
the second one's intercourse does not count as intercourse.
If the first one's intercourse does not count as intercourse,
the second one's intercourse also does not count as intercourse.
And the intercourse of a nine-year-old
is something the Rabbis made like levirate betrothal,
and Rabbi Shimon says the second one's intercourse does not count.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next name on רבי יוחנן's list, following בית שמאי.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי שמעון holds מאמר fully acquires the יבמה
steps.raayaSupportSource: רבי שמעון's ברייתא about a nine-year-old's ביאה, which the Rabbis compare to מאמר

steps.title: The source for including בן עזאי
steps.stepSummary: בן עזאי says a second מאמר does nothing when one יבם does מאמר with two יבמות. This shows the first מאמר fully acquired the first woman.
steps.simpleTranslation: The source for בן עזאי is a ברייתא: בן עזאי says: A מאמר after a מאמר works when there are two יבמין and one יבמה. But a מאמר after a מאמר does not work when there are two יבמות and one יבם.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows why רבי יוחנן listed בן עזאי. It quotes his rule about when a second מאמר works and when it does not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With one יבם and two יבמות, his first מאמר acquires the first woman fully, so his second מאמר to the other woman means nothing. That is exactly the view that מאמר is a full acquisition, like רבן גמליאל in step 7.

keyTerms.meaning: A second levirate betrothal after a first one
Brothers-in-law who are obligated in ייבום
Widows waiting for ייבום

phrases.aramaic: בֶּן עַזַּאי — דְּתַנְיָא, בֶּן עַזַּאי אוֹמֵר:
phrases.english: Ben Azzai — as it is taught in a baraita: Ben Azzai says:
Levirate betrothal works after levirate betrothal
when there are two brothers-in-law and one widow,
but levirate betrothal does not work after levirate betrothal
when there are two widows and one brother-in-law.

steps.triggerLanguage: בֶּן עַזַּאי — דְּתַנְיָא, בֶּן עַזַּאי אוֹמֵר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next name on רבי יוחנן's list, following רבי שמעון.
steps.raayaObject: That בן עזאי holds מאמר fully acquires the יבמה
steps.raayaSupportSource: בן עזאי's ברייתא: אין מאמר אחר מאמר בשתי יבמות ויבם אחד

steps.title: The source for including רבי נחמיה
steps.stepSummary: רבי נחמיה says nothing works after ביאה or חליצה, even a ביאה פסולה. Since the Rabbis treat ביאה פסולה like מאמר, רבי נחמיה must hold that מאמר is a full acquisition.
steps.simpleTranslation: The source for רבי נחמיה is a משנה: רבי נחמיה says: Whether it is ביאה or חליצה, at the beginning, the middle, or the end, nothing works after it. Now, a ביאה פסולה is treated by the Rabbis like מאמר, and he teaches that nothing works after it.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows why רבי יוחנן listed רבי נחמיה, the last name on his list. It quotes his rule that nothing works after a ביאה, even one that comes in the middle or end of a series.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A ביאה that comes in the middle or at the end is a ביאה פסולה, which the Rabbis say has only the power of מאמר. רבי נחמיה still says it blocks everything after it. So for him, an act with the strength of מאמר acquires her completely.

keyTerms.meaning: Relations, here as an act of ייבום
Relations that do not fully count, which the Rabbis treat like מאמר
Nothing works after it

keyTerms.term: בֵּין בַּתְּחִלָּה בֵּין בָּאֶמְצַע בֵּין בַּסּוֹף
keyTerms.meaning: Whether at the beginning, in the middle, or at the end of a series of acts

steps.whatToRemember: All five names on רבי יוחנן's list have now been proven. Each source shows that מאמר, or an act the Rabbis made equal to מאמר, fully acquires the יבמה and blocks what comes after it.

phrases.english: Rabbi Nechemya — as we learned in a mishna:
Rabbi Nechemya says:
Both intercourse and ḥalitza,

phrases.aramaic: בֵּין בַּתְּחִלָּה בֵּין בָּאֶמְצַע בֵּין בַּסּוֹף —
phrases.english: whether at the beginning, in the middle, or at the end,
nothing works after it.
And invalid intercourse
is something the Rabbis made like levirate betrothal,
and he teaches: nothing works after it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The final name on רבי יוחנן's list, following בן עזאי.

steps.title: Back to the משנה: 'How so? He did מאמר'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא goes back to the משנה and quotes its next line, 'כיצד? עשה מאמר', to begin explaining it.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: How so? If he did מאמר, and so on.
steps.whatsHappening: The list of sources is done, and the גמרא returns to the משנה. It quotes the opening words of the next part of the משנה, setting up the discussion that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This line opens a new section. The משנה here starts giving examples of a יבם doing מאמר and then other acts like a גט, and the גמרא will now discuss that section.
